name: tailwindcss-buttons
title: Tailwind CSS Buttons
description: A showcase grid of tall black cards, each holding one button in a different style: solid white, outline, filled blue, outlined blue, purple gradient or grey. Hovering a card reveals a small copy icon.
use: Choosing a button style from a set of ready-made dark-theme variants for a new interface.
avoid: You need a reusable button: the six looks are demo class strings, not part of the component.
a11y: The card is a clickable div with no role or key handling, and the clipboard icon has no accessible label. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A two-by-three grid of tall black rounded cards on a dark stage, each holding one horizontal pill or softly rounded button in white, blue, purple gradient or grey. A faint dot texture fills every card, and a tiny clipboard icon sits in the top-right corner on hover.
behaves: Hovering a card reveals a small clipboard icon in its corner. Hovering each button darkens, lightens or fills it depending on its style; nothing else moves.
customise: Children render inside the card and className merges onto it; the six button styles and their colours live in the demo, not the component.
weight: light: Six static cards with plain CSS hover transitions; no animation loop.
demo: Labels: Get started, Sign up free, Learn more, Explore docs, Download, Contact sales.
issues: The Get started button is black on the black card, nearly invisible until hovered.
The clipboard icon suggests copying but the component never copies anything.
No focus styling on the clickable card.
polishWhy: Tidy grid and consistent cards; one button vanishes into its card and the copy icon is decorative.
